recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-32528 unless a future PA decision changes the one-instance-per-non-adjacent-period guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-32528 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking to add a RelatedPerson.period usage comment explaining that a person with a patient relationship over multiple non-adjacent periods should be represented by distinct RelatedPerson instances, one per period.
initial_application: The issue was directly applied by git commit b71ae1896e18d85b7a682a70dee34feb182ccfbf, "FHIR-32528 Added Comment to RelatedPerson.period", which inserted the requested comment into source/relatedperson/structuredefinition-RelatedPerson.xml. Current blame still attributes the comment line to that commit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists relatedperson=RelatedPerson as an active resource, so the inspected StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. PA January 2022 WGM minutes reference FHIR-32528 and repeat the intended RelatedPerson.period comment text. The analogous PractitionerRole issue FHIR-32495 was found but concerns a separate resource and was not decided.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/relatedperson/structuredefinition-RelatedPerson.xml already contains the exact non-adjacent-period guidance requested by FHIR-32528, and no later conflicting evidence was found.

related_jiras.note: Analogous Published/Persuasive PractitionerRole.period tracker found in Jira search; it concerns PractitionerRole rather than the seed RelatedPerson artifact and was not decided here.
